agent_review.author: agent

findings.summary: Lildozer fainted only after two Bulldozes and a verified Ice Shard reduced Ponyta to 2 HP; Croakatoa then finished without taking damage. No safer legal switch was verified to dominate.

Poisoned 5-HP Bushtank attempted one final Razor Leaf and fainted to Mega Drain, but it had already dealt three Razor Leaf hits and preserved full-HP Croakatoa; sacrificing it avoided exposing a strategic reserve.
Birdlaw traded two Aerial Aces for Dustox damage and Bugatti's forced Rollout then KO'd Dustox, damaged Sunflora, and fainted; full-HP Croakatoa safely completed the fight.

All eight switches were purposeful: three matchup pivots and five forced replacements. Every voluntary replacement attacked before leaving, with no reversal, consecutive switch stall, or no-action switch spam.
The fight used 28 decisions; no shorter alternative was verified to improve survival or reserve preservation.

correct_choices: Croakatoa pivoted directly to Bushtank against Eelektrik, and Bushtank attacked until it could no longer preserve useful HP.
No move was wasted into deterministic sleep, freeze, or paralysis; all 19 committed move PP decrements produced cartridge effects.
Ohmnomnom and Croakatoa used fresh-entry Fake Out only when legal and converted each free turn into damage rather than switch churn.
Croakatoa-to-Birdlaw handled Dustox, and forced Bugatti Rollout converted the 6-HP Dustox endgame into Sunflora damage.
The terminal state authoritatively verified victory with Croakatoa untouched at 46/46 HP.
agent_review.next_test: Run unchanged-bundle Clone 2 from the identical opening; repeat the all-switch audit, deterministic-status audit, and preservation of Croakatoa for the terminal phase.
